translation_identity.source:
Draw in the raging fires and envelop yourself in them. Remove all burns from enemies in a radius of 5 around you, and create a shield lasting %d turns with a power of %d, increased by 15%% for each burn removed.
		When the shield ends, it releases a burst of fire in a radius of %d around you, burning all enemies for 3 turns, doing damage equal to the initial power of the shield.
translation_identity.target_before:
吸取燃烧中的烈焰，将自己包裹其中。
		除去半径 5 内的敌方生物身上的燃烧效果，同时制造一层持续 %d 轮的 %d 强度的护盾，每吸收一层燃烧效果护盾强度增加 15%%。
		当护盾效果结束时，将在半径 %d 范围内释放一次火焰爆炸，灼烧周围生物 3 回合，造成等于护盾初始值的伤害。
translation_identity.target_after:
吸取燃烧中的烈焰，将自己包裹其中。
		除去半径 10 内的敌方生物身上的燃烧效果，同时制造一层持续 %d 轮的 %d 强度的护盾，每吸收一层燃烧效果护盾强度增加 15%%。
		当护盾效果结束时，将在半径 %d 范围内释放一次火焰爆炸，灼烧范围内的所有敌方生物 3 回合，造成等于护盾初始值的伤害。

status_control_identity.source: The target is surrounded by a magical shield, absorbing %d/%d damage before it crumbles and dealing %d damage in a radius of %d when it does.
status_control_identity.target_before: 目标被一层魔法护盾包围，吸收 %d/%d 伤害，护盾结束时（无论吸收耗尽还是自然到期），引燃持续 3 回合、总计造成 %d 伤害且范围为半径 %d 的灼烧。
status_control_identity.target_after: 目标被一层魔法护盾包围，吸收 %d/%d 伤害，护盾结束时（无论吸收耗尽还是自然到期），对周围敌方生物施加持续 3 回合的灼烧，总计造成 %d 伤害，作用半径为 %d。

runtime_source_anchors.fact: T_FIERY_AEGIS.action projects a range-0 ball with radius=10 and friendlyfire=false; its info supplies shield duration, shield power and burst radius as exactly three arguments.
EFF_FIRE_SHIELD.deactivate projects FIREBURN with radius=eff.radius, friendlyfire=false, dur=3 and damage based on eff.power.
ActorProject.project excludes reaction-nonnegative actors when friendlyfire=false before invoking the projection callback.
Target.getType/ball retains the explicit target radius without rewriting it.
